For this 36-year-old female patient, the decision to undergo Breast Augmentation in Boston was driven by a desire for fuller, more symmetric breasts. The elective procedure involved the submuscular placement of 470cc ultra-high profile, round-shaped silicone implants with a highly cohesive gel, often referred to as 'Gummy Bear Implants'. The operation was carried out using an inframammary incision type to ensure less noticeable scarring. Upon viewing the before and after photos from this patient's procedure, the transformation is remarkable and achieves her desired aesthetic outcome.

The patient's experience was marked by a comprehensive treatment plan, aimed at matching her unique physique and personal motivations. As part of her surgical strategy, the use of 'xtra high' profile implants was adopted to suit her specific anatomical requirements and aesthetic goals. The end result is a visibly enhanced bosom that is symmetrical, natural-looking and well-proportioned to her frame. Her satisfaction post-procedure underscores the success of the treatment plan and the skillful execution of the operation.

Dax Guenther, MD FACS, a board-certified plastic surgeon, was the expert behind this successful breast augmentation procedure. Graduating from prestigious institutions such as Princeton University and The Ohio State University College of Medicine and with residencies at Massachusetts General Hospital and UCLA, Dr. Guenther brings a wealth of experience and expertise to his practice at Coastal Plastic Surgery in Hingham and Nantucket, MA. His meticulous attention to detail, an unwavering commitment to patient care, and his talent for combining artistic creativity with surgical precision are evident in the patient's outcomes. This speaks volumes about his profound understanding of individualized treatments and the pursuit of natural-looking results.
